# czc-v2026.10.27.2 (0.2.18.4)

Stops the admin “sync latest supported models” action from putting retired
`gpt-5.5` back onto OpenAI account whitelists.

## Changes since czc-v2026.10.27.1

- The local OpenAI account catalog no longer lists `gpt-5.5`. Clicking
  「同步最新支持模型」 therefore no longer re-adds it to `model_mapping`.
- The matching GPT-5.5 identity and Claude→GPT-5.5 shortcut mappings are
  removed from the account editor. Existing mappings are not rewritten by
  this change; production `gpt-5.5` keys were already removed from accounts
  and group allowlists before this release.
- 「同步上游支持的模型」 is unchanged and still uses the live upstream list.

## VERSION

`0.2.18.4`

## Upgrade guidance and compatibility

- No database migration or configuration change is required.
- Operators must rebuild the frontend into `backend/internal/web/dist`
  immediately before the `-tags embed` server build. A new VERSION with a
  stale dist would still ship the old catalog.
- After deploy, existing account mappings stay as stored. Only later
  「同步最新支持模型」 clicks stop re-adding `gpt-5.5`.
- 「同步上游支持的模型」 can still add `gpt-5.5` if OpenAI’s live catalog
  still returns it.

## Verification

Passed on `dev-czc` after merging `fix/drop-retired-gpt-55-catalog`:

- `pnpm exec eslint` on `useModelWhitelist.ts` and its spec (exit 0).
- `pnpm exec vitest run src/composables/__tests__/useModelWhitelist.spec.ts`
  (18 tests, exit 0).

Failed, interrupted or not performed:

- Frontend `vue-tsc` / full Vitest / Playwright were not run. The change is
  limited to the OpenAI account catalog and its unit tests.
- Backend unit, integration, golangci-lint and e2e tests were not run. No
  Go source changed.
- Production account mappings were already cleaned in a separate admin
  operation and are not part of this binary.

Packaging must rebuild the frontend immediately before the `-tags embed`
server build from this exact tag, with `main.ReleaseURL` set to this origin
release. Installation is accepted only after the root page returns HTTP 200,
the installed version is `0.2.18.4`, and the running update-check response
reports this same release URL.

## Rollback

Restore the binary backed up during this deploy as
`/opt/sub2api/sub2api.bak.czc-v2026.10.27.2-<UTC timestamp>` and restart
`sub2api.service`, or rebuild and deploy `czc-v2026.10.27.1` (`0.2.18.3`).
There is no database migration or configuration change to undo. Verify HTTP
200, version `0.2.18.3` and the previous origin release URL after rollback.
